title: feat: allow selecting which disks are shown in health monitoring / disks widgets
body:
## Describe the feature you'd like to request

In the OMV integration, allow the user to choose which disks are shown in the health monitoring (System Health Monitoring) and disks (System Disks) widgets.

This was requested by the reporter of #6615 (which fixed disk temperature/status showing as N/A for OMV). Their exact words:

> thank you so much it seems to be working very well, the only thing I might add would be maybe the possibility of being able to choose which disks are shown

**Context:** OMV can report multiple disks, some of which have no SMART data (e.g. virtual drives without SMART). Currently all disks returned by the integration are displayed, so disks without SMART data (temperature N/A, unknown status) still appear in the widget. The reporter explicitly said this was *not* meant as part of the bug fix — it's a separate enhancement.

## Additional information

- Originating request: https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/issues/6615
- Related fix: https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/pull/6619
- Proposed approach: a per-widget option to include/exclude specific disks (by device name), similar to how storage volume selection already works in `packages/widgets/src/filter-storage-volumes.ts`
